title: EsriFootprint
description: Read-only inventory of an Esri estate (ArcGIS Online, ArcGIS Server, or FileGDB) produced by honua-esri-assess and consumed by the closed Honua migration product. Schema version esri-footprint/v0.2 (full SemVer in $id). v0.2 is additive over v0.1: it introduces the optional top-level dependencyEdges array (webmap -> service -> layer) for migration ordering and accepts v0.1 artifacts unchanged. v0.x is unstable — breaking changes are permitted within v0.x; v1.0 is the first stable promise.

schemaVersion.description: Major.minor of the contract carried in-band. v0.2 producers emit "v0.2"; "v0.1" remains valid so v0.1 artifacts validate against the v0.2 reader. Full SemVer (e.g. v0.2.0) lives in $id.

generatedAt.description: When the scanner finished producing this artifact (RFC3339 UTC).

inventory.description: Normalized records from the scanned source, discriminated by EsriItem.kind. Portal items, Server services, and FileGDB feature classes coexist in a single list.

diagnostics.description: Typed, prospect-safe diagnostics surfaced during scanning. Raw exceptions and stack traces are forbidden by project constraint and excluded from the schema.

RFC3339.description: RFC3339 UTC date-time string with an explicit Z suffix.

SemVer.description: Semantic version string (MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH with optional pre-release/build metadata).

ToolProvenance.description: Scanner provenance. version is required so consumers can reason about which scanner produced the artifact.

name.description: Always honua-esri-assess at v0.1; other producers are not part of the contract.

Source.description: Identifies the scanned Esri source. Discriminated by kind. locator must be a prospect-safe identifier — never credentials, never raw on-prem paths; FileGDB paths are surfaced as a salted hash. locator format is constrained by kind via the allOf branches below.

locator.description: Prospect-safe identifier for the source. AGOL: host + organization id (e.g. honua.maps.arcgis.com/0123ABC). Server: base services URL with no query string, fragment, or userinfo. FileGDB: salted sha256 of the gdb path (sha256:<64 hex>).

capturedAt.description: When the scan against this source began.

SpatialReference.description: Spatial reference identification. Esri publishes wkid, latestWkid, or wkt inconsistently — at least one must be present. Closed object: producers must normalize to the documented keys before emitting.

Extent.description: Bounding box and spatial reference for an item or layer.

bbox.description: [xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax] in the crs coordinate system.

GeometryType.description: Esri geometry type tag. null is allowed for tables and non-spatial items.

FieldDescriptor.description: Minimal field metadata captured for FileGDB feature classes. Closed object: extras require a schema bump.

type.description: Esri field type tag (e.g. esriFieldTypeOID, esriFieldTypeString).

EsriTypeCountMap.description: Map of Esri item or service type labels to counts. Property names are constrained to display-label characters so URLs, query tokens, credential strings, and raw path fragments cannot be carried as map keys.

DependencyNodeId.description: Prospect-safe identifier for a dependency-graph node. Portal items use the portal item id. Server services use the credential-free serviceUrl. Server layers use "<serviceUrl>#<layerId>". Identifiers must already appear in the inventory (or be derivable from it) and must never carry credentials, query strings, fragments other than the layer suffix, or raw on-prem paths.

DependencyEdge.description: A single directed dependency edge used for migration ordering. The "from" node depends on / references the "to" node, so "to" must be migrated first. Closed object: extras require a schema bump.

relation.description: Edge kind. webmap-references-service: a portal Web Map references a service (item id or service). service-contains-layer: an ArcGIS Server service contains a layer.

DependencyEdges.description: Optional, deterministic list of directed dependency edges (webmap -> service -> layer) reserved but left empty at v0.1 and populated at v0.2. Absent or empty for sources without resolvable edges. Consumers use these to order migrations: for an edge {from, to}, "to" is migrated before "from".

PortalFacet.description: Facet required iff source.kind == arcgis-online. Closed at v0.1: vendor extras, callback URLs, and credential-like fields are schema-rejected so the artifact cannot smuggle telemetry or secrets.

orgUrl.description: ArcGIS Online organization base URL. Schema pattern rejects userinfo, query strings, and fragments so credentials and session tokens cannot ride along.

itemCounts.description: Map of Esri item type → count (e.g. "Feature Service": 12). Keys are constrained to prospect-safe type labels.

contentTypeCounts.description: Additive at v0.2: map of functional content category → count (e.g. "web-map": 8, "survey123-form": 3, "unknown": 1). Categories are derived from the item type and typeKeywords (apps, forms, notebooks, hosted vs referenced layers, etc.); unrecognized content is counted as "unknown". v0.1 readers ignore this property.

sharingSummary.description: Roll-up of sharing levels across portal items.

licensing.description: Read-only license entitlement observations from documented Portal Sharing endpoints.

ServerFacet.description: Facet required iff source.kind == arcgis-server. Closed at v0.1: vendor extras, callback URLs, and credential-like fields are schema-rejected so the artifact cannot smuggle telemetry or secrets.

folders.description: Top-level service folder names visited by the scan. Empty array if all services live at the root; filtered scans may contain only the requested folder.

serviceCounts.description: Map of Esri service type → count (e.g. "MapServer": 4). Keys are constrained to prospect-safe type labels.

licensing.description: Read-only license entitlement observations from documented ArcGIS Server REST/admin endpoints.

bindingPlan.description: Additive at v0.2: usage-ranked migration ordering and per-dataset binding-mode recommendations derived from read-only Admin-API usage reports (/admin/usagereports) and data-store registrations (/admin/data/items). Present only when the admin usage pull was enabled and the admin endpoints were reachable; absent otherwise so plain scans and v0.1 readers are unchanged.

UsageRankedService.description: One service ranked by observed request volume from /admin/usagereports. Drives usage-driven migration sequencing rather than alphabetical/folder heuristics.

service.description: Service identifier as the Admin-API reports it (folder/Name.Type style), with the leading services/ prefix stripped. Never carries credentials or query strings.

requests.description: Total observed request count summed across the usage-report samples.

rank.description: 1-based migration rank; lower rank = higher observed usage. Ties break alphabetically for determinism.

DatasetBinding.description: Per-dataset binding-mode recommendation derived only from a data-store registration's declared storage type. Connection strings, hosts, usernames, and passwords are never read or emitted; ArcSDE/GDB internals are never parsed.

datasetId.description: Registration path/id as reported by /admin/data/items (e.g. /enterpriseDatabases/parcels_egdb). Never carries a connection string or credentials.

storageType.description: Declared registration type token verbatim (e.g. egdb, cloudStore, folder). Read from the registration's declared type only, never inferred from internals.

connectionKind.description: Coarse, credential-free classification of the registration derived from its declared storageType. Unknown tokens map to "unknown".

bindingMode.description: Recommended Honua binding mode. federate: query in place at scale (enterprise geodatabases / relational stores). connect-in-place: register a direct read-only connection without copying (cloud/object/big-data file shares). materialize: copy/snapshot into Honua-managed storage (file shares and unmapped types).

BindingPlan.description: Combined usage-ranking + binding-mode planning facet derived from read-only Admin-API endpoints. Both arrays may be empty when the corresponding endpoint returned no data.

usageRankedServices.description: Services ranked by observed request volume (descending), used to drive usage-driven migration sequencing.

datasetBindings.description: Per-dataset binding-mode recommendations derived only from data-store registration storage types.

ExtensionEntitlement.description: One Esri extension or add-on observed during read-only entitlement enumeration.

code.description: Esri extension code as reported by the source, or the catalog-normalized equivalent.

UserTypeCount.description: Portal user-type entitlement count. Seat counts are omitted when the endpoint does not expose them for the scanner credential.

PortalPremiumContent.description: Portal premium content and add-on entitlement summary. Credit balances are intentionally reduced to a boolean.

PortalLicensing.description: Portal / ArcGIS Online licensing observations from read-only Sharing API endpoints.

ServiceExtensionRecord.description: SOEs and SOIs enabled on one ArcGIS Server service.

serviceUrl.description: Credentials-stripped service URL. Query strings, fragments, and userinfo are forbidden.

ServerLicensing.description: ArcGIS Server licensing observations from read-only REST/admin endpoints.

FileGdbFacet.description: Facet required iff source.kind == filegdb. Closed at v0.1: vendor extras, callback URLs, and credential-like fields are schema-rejected so the artifact cannot smuggle telemetry or secrets.

pathHash.description: Salted sha256 of the FileGDB path. The raw path is never published.

version.description: FileGDB format version reported by the reader, when available.

EsriItem.description: Discriminated union of normalized inventory records. Variants are closed at v0.1: extras require a schema bump so the artifact cannot smuggle credentials or telemetry fields per item.

type.description: Esri portal item type (e.g. "Feature Service", "Web Map").

contentCategory.description: Additive at v0.2: functional content category derived from the item type and typeKeywords (apps, forms, notebooks, hosted vs referenced layers, etc.). Unrecognized content is recorded as "unknown". v0.1 readers ignore this property.

dependencies.description: Portal item ids this item references (e.g. webmap → services). Edges between layers/services are deferred to v0.2.

serviceUrl.description: Fully-qualified service URL with no query string, fragment, or userinfo. Credentials must never appear in this field.

serviceType.description: Esri service type (e.g. MapServer, FeatureServer, ImageServer).

folder.description: Folder name relative to the services root, or empty string if the service lives at the root.

layerCount.description: Number of layers observed for the service. Current ArcGIS Server producer output fills this from deep service probes; shallow or unprobed services emit 0.

serviceKind.description: Coarse migration bucket for serviceType. Non-feature/map services (image, geocode, geoprocessing, scene, stream, network-analysis, vector-tile, ...) are classified explicitly; unrecognized raw types map to "other" rather than being dropped.

ogcCapabilities.description: OGC interfaces advertised on the service via its supportedExtensions (WMS/WFS/WCS). Omitted when the service advertises none. Deterministic, sorted, de-duplicated.

layers.description: Additive at v0.2: per-layer schema and behavior detail captured from each FeatureServer/MapServer layer's read-only metadata (fields, domains, relationships, attachments, editor tracking, renderer/labels/popups, definition query, spatial reference). Present only when the layer-detail probe ran and at least one layer was resolved; absent otherwise so plain probes are unchanged. v0.1 readers ignore this property.

migrationHandoff.description: Additive at v0.2: cross-repo migration handoff for geoprocessing (GPServer) services. Geoprocessing migration is owned by honua-sdk-python's ArcPy scanner/translator/runner; this footprint records only a read-only pointer (service URL, any known task names, and a note). Present only on geoprocessingService entries; absent otherwise. v0.1 readers ignore this property.

serviceUrl.description: Credential-free GPServer URL. Credentials must never appear in this field.

note.description: Human-readable note pointing migration at the owning ArcPy pipeline.

taskNames.description: Geoprocessing task names read from the GPServer body's tasks array (deep probe only). Omitted when no tasks were resolved. Deterministic, sorted, de-duplicated.

lockIns.description: Additive at v0.2: enumerated hard Esri lock-ins (Utility Network / Parcel Fabric / LRS) carried by the service, with observed extent. Present only when the service carries at least one lock-in; absent otherwise so plain feature/map services and v0.1 readers are unchanged.

ServerLayerDetail.description: Schema and behavior detail for one FeatureServer/MapServer layer or table, read-only from its metadata resource. Closed object: extras require a schema bump.

name.description: Layer/table name as reported by the service.

subtypeCount.description: Number of subtypes defined on the layer.

rendererType.description: drawingInfo renderer type (e.g. simple, uniqueValue, classBreaks).

ServerLayerField.description: One attribute field on a layer/table. Domain presence is summarized as a coded/range/inherited type plus the domain name; coded-value lists are not copied.

type.description: Esri field type tag (e.g. esriFieldTypeOID, esriFieldTypeString).

domainType.description: Domain kind summary: coded, range, inherited, or a raw type when unrecognized.

editorTracking.description: True when the field is one of the layer's editor-tracking columns.

ServerLayerRelationship.description: One relationship class advertised on a layer.

ServerLayerEditorTracking.description: Editor-tracking configuration observed on a layer.

LockIn.description: An enumerated hard Esri lock-in (Utility Network, Parcel Fabric, LRS) observed on a service, with extent. Additive at v0.2; v0.1 readers ignore it. The tool never migrates these capabilities — the enumeration exists so the migratability verdict can report extent (e.g. "UN: N feature classes") rather than a bare presence flag.

type.description: Hard lock-in identifier, matching the verdict capability registry keys.

featureClassCount.description: Number of feature classes participating in the lock-in (Utility Network / Parcel Fabric).

domainNetworkCount.description: Number of Utility Network domain networks observed.

ruleCount.description: Number of Utility Network rules observed.

Counts.description: Aggregate roll-up of the inventory. Top-level closed so adding a new aggregate is a deliberate schema bump.

items.description: Totals by EsriItem.kind: portal-item, server-service, filegdb-feature-class.

layers.description: Sum of layerCount across server-service items.

Diagnostic.description: Typed, prospect-safe diagnostic. code is drawn from a locked v0.1 enum; new codes require a v0.2 vocabulary expansion. Clarifying existing codes may land in a v0.1.x doc bump.

message.description: Human-readable summary. Must not contain raw stack traces, credentials, or full on-prem paths.

scope.description: Identifier of the affected area — usually source.kind, a folder, or an EsriItem identifier.

hint.description: Optional remediation hint surfaced to the prospect.
